name: Views Current Path
description: Defines a views field that prints the path of the page currently being viewed.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Important 
 We'd appreciate your help testing the D8 version of this module so that we can progress this to a stable implementation - of particular value is testing on multilingual sites.

 Back to top 

 About 
 Provides a Views field that displays the URL of the current page being viewed.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 Create/edit your view and add a new field. In the "Add fields" window, choose "Global: Current Path". Configure the field options and apply it to your display.

 There are many use-cases for this functionality. The most common is to use the "Rewrite results" section in other fields where you can use this field token (i.e. [current_path]) in the text or adding it to the "Output this field as a link" input box.

 Back to top 

 Notes 
 The Drupal 7 version of this module will only receive bug fixes effective 20th April 2018. Development of new features (where appropriate) will take place against the D8 version.
